name: A Steppe To The Sun
description: A broad island realm baked by a dry sun: a wind-scoured steppe where goat- and camel-herders scratch their prayers into living rock, a hot southern waste of dunes and cracked hardpan, and between them a thin chain of oases and irrigated fields fed by the melt seeps of a western massif. A bronze-age hillfort guards the passes; pale ruins of an older people rise from the burning sand.
visualTheme: dry steppe and desert island, ochre and bleached stone, low red sun

pois.name: The Sunglow Massif
pois.description: A dry grey range walling off the north-western shore, its naked spurs catching the low red light of dawn and dusk; the seeps from its deep springs feed the oases far below.

pois.name: The Windever Steppe
pois.description: Open, sun-baked grassland on the island's broad northern plain, grazed thin by the herders' small, hardy flocks.

pois.name: Azure Dunes
pois.description: A scatter of low goat-hair tents and dry-stone pens ringed against the wind — the camp of the steppe herders, who bow to no lord of the oasis.

pois.name: The Mirage Oasis
pois.description: A double ring of palms and sweet water where the steppe begins to burn — the deck of the herders' summer trade.

pois.name: Amber Harbor
pois.description: The one true city of the dust: a press of ochre houses, dye-vats and cameltraders' caravanserai ringed around the great oasis, grown rich on salt, spices and the highland iron.

pois.name: Temple of the Standing Sun
pois.description: A squat, sun-dried sanctuary on a low mesa, its walls etched with ten thousand prayers scratched by pilgrims who crossed the waste.

pois.name: The Sandsea
pois.description: A blinding waste of dunes and cracked hardpan on the hot southern cape where nothing grows but thorn.

pois.name: The Bone-Temple of the First Dynasty
pois.description: Bleached stone columns rising from the sand, older than the herders' oldest song.

pois.name: Ember Heights
pois.description: A bronze-age hillfort of rough rammed earth and timber, watching the passes between steppe, oasis and shore.

pois.name: The Palefield Freehold
pois.description: A rare holding of irrigated wheat and groves along the oasis-feed channel, worked by a stubborn family of free farmers.

pois.name: Flintgate
pois.description: A mine at the massif's southern foot, digging copper and good hard flint for blade and arrow.

pois.name: The Dune Watch
pois.description: A lone tower on the northern steppe edge, set to watch the hard road and the burning south.

pois.name: Windcatch Cove
pois.description: A hidden crescent of calm shallows on the western shore where the island's few sheltering boats lie.

pois.name: The Saltedge
pois.description: A low red cliff where the eastern shore meets the sea, banded white with old salt where the waves have dried for a thousand years.

lore.history: The first herders came out of the north across the winter ice and found the steppe endless and the water scarce. Their rock-scritchings still line every bluff. The oasis city rose later, when the high western seeps were tamed into the feed-channels, and for three generations the hillfort at Ember Heights has kept the passes between dust and watered land.
rumors: The Bone-Temple's columns hum in the south wind before rain
A white camel drinking at the Mirage at dead noon is an omen of a dry year
The Dune Watch saw dust-clouds on the eastern horizon that no herd could raise
